- [PASS] Knee Flexion (120.9° vs optimal 100°–145° dip): Balanced knee load transferring momentum smoothly upward.
- [FAULT] Release Angle (35.2° vs optimal 45°–58° (52° ideal)): Aim forearm trajectory higher at release (around 50°–55°) to improve basket entry arc.
- [PASS] Base Stability (29.4° tilt vs optimal <48.7° tilt): Stable upright core maintaining straight vertical alignment.
- [FAULT] Follow-Through (74.7° ext vs optimal ≥155° full ext): Fully lock out your shooting elbow and hold the downward wrist snap until the ball lands.

**Prescriptive Coaching Drill - One-Handed Wall Touches (4 sets of 15 repetitions):**
Pushing the ball outward rather than elevating upward flattens your launch angle, increasing sensitivity to release velocity errors and causing front-rim misses.
Action Cue: Keep your shooting elbow tucked above eyebrow level before initiating upward thrust.

- [FAULT] Release Angle (0.0° vs optimal 45°–58° (52° ideal)): Aim forearm trajectory higher at release (around 50°–55°) to improve basket entry arc.

**Prescriptive Coaching Drill - One-Handed Wall Touches (4 sets of 15 repetitions):**

Action Cue: Keep your shooting elbow tucked above eyebrow level before initiating upward thrust.

- PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip (Frame 16 / 0.53s): Elbow 90.5 deg, Knee 120.2 deg
- PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point (Frame 18 / 0.6s): Elbow 90.7 deg, Knee 127.8 deg

Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.

Given Moving-Sticks 3D-to-2D sagittal pose kinematics and phase telemetry extracted from uploaded video, identify the biomechanical fault class, audit all 5 checkpoints, quantify angle deviations, and prescribe targeted corrective drills.

Break down the 4 biomechanical keyframes and identify the primary shooting fault for a Power Forward (Min Elbow=87.72 deg, Max Extension=137.84 deg, Trunk Tilt=30.68 deg, Release=0.0 deg, Wrist-Knee Lag=-4f).
input: {"sample_id": "AIM-0581", "athlete_position": "Power Forward", "shot_context": "top-of-the-key pull-up jumper", "min_elbow_deg": 87.72, "max_elbow_extension_deg": 137.84, "min_knee_flexion_deg": 122.98, "max_trunk_tilt_deg": 30.68, "release_elevation_deg": 0.0, "wrist_to_knee_lag_frames": -4, "keyframes": [{"phase": "PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip", "frame": 16, "time_sec": 0.53, "elbow_deg": 88.4, "knee_deg": 123.0}, {"phase": "PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point", "frame": 19, "time_sec": 0.63, "elbow_deg": 88.5, "knee_deg": 134.1}, {"phase": "PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex", "frame": 25, "time_sec": 0.83, "elbow_deg": 88.6, "knee_deg": 177.0}, {"phase": "PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold", "frame": 59, "time_sec": 1.97, "elbow_deg": 137.8, "knee_deg": 167.7}]}
output:
### Primary Diagnosis: Short Follow-Through (Score: 75/100, Severity: Moderate Form Fault)

**Identified 4-Phase Keyframes:**
- PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip (Frame 16 / 0.53s): Elbow 88.4 deg, Knee 123.0 deg
- PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point (Frame 19 / 0.63s): Elbow 88.5 deg, Knee 134.1 deg
- PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex (Frame 25 / 0.83s): Elbow 88.6 deg, Knee 177.0 deg
- PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold (Frame 59 / 1.97s): Elbow 137.8 deg, Knee 167.7 deg

**5-Checkpoint Audit:**
- [PASS] Elbow Alignment (87.7° vs optimal 85°–95°): Good elbow stack directly under the ball during loading.
- [PASS] Knee Flexion (123.0° vs optimal 100°–145° dip): Balanced knee load transferring momentum smoothly upward.
- [FAULT] Release Angle (0.0° vs optimal 45°–58° (52° ideal)): Aim forearm trajectory higher at release (around 50°–55°) to improve basket entry arc.
- [PASS] Base Stability (30.7° tilt vs optimal <48.7° tilt): Stable upright core maintaining straight vertical alignment.
- [FAULT] Follow-Through (137.8° ext vs optimal ≥155° full ext): Fully lock out your shooting elbow and hold the downward wrist snap until the ball lands.

**Prescriptive Coaching Drill - Gooey Wrist-Snap Holds (3 sets of 20 repetitions):**
Truncating wrist extension immediately after release eliminates aerodynamic backspin, producing inconsistent ball flight and unpredictable bounces off the rim.
Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.

Given Moving-Sticks 3D-to-2D sagittal pose kinematics and phase telemetry extracted from uploaded video, identify the biomechanical fault class, audit all 5 checkpoints, quantify angle deviations, and prescribe targeted corrective drills.

Break down the 4 biomechanical keyframes and identify the primary shooting fault for a Shooting Guard (Min Elbow=89.76 deg, Max Extension=141.6 deg, Trunk Tilt=32.32 deg, Release=0.0 deg, Wrist-Knee Lag=-5f).
input: {"sample_id": "AIM-0649", "athlete_position": "Shooting Guard", "shot_context": "free-throw routine under fatigue (Q4)", "min_elbow_deg": 89.76, "max_elbow_extension_deg": 141.6, "min_knee_flexion_deg": 121.82, "max_trunk_tilt_deg": 32.32, "release_elevation_deg": 0.0, "wrist_to_knee_lag_frames": -5, "keyframes": [{"phase": "PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip", "frame": 16, "time_sec": 0.53, "elbow_deg": 91.7, "knee_deg": 121.8}, {"phase": "PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point", "frame": 25, "time_sec": 0.83, "elbow_deg": 90.5, "knee_deg": 176.8}, {"phase": "PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex", "frame": 26, "time_sec": 0.87, "elbow_deg": 90.5, "knee_deg": 175.3}, {"phase": "PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold", "frame": 59, "time_sec": 1.97, "elbow_deg": 141.6, "knee_deg": 166.1}]}
output:
### Primary Diagnosis: Short Follow-Through (Score: 75/100, Severity: Minor Form Deviation)

**Identified 4-Phase Keyframes:**
- PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip (Frame 16 / 0.53s): Elbow 91.7 deg, Knee 121.8 deg
- PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point (Frame 25 / 0.83s): Elbow 90.5 deg, Knee 176.8 deg
- PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex (Frame 26 / 0.87s): Elbow 90.5 deg, Knee 175.3 deg
- PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold (Frame 59 / 1.97s): Elbow 141.6 deg, Knee 166.1 deg

**5-Checkpoint Audit:**
- [PASS] Elbow Alignment (89.8° vs optimal 85°–95°): Good elbow stack directly under the ball during loading.
- [PASS] Knee Flexion (121.8° vs optimal 100°–145° dip): Balanced knee load transferring momentum smoothly upward.
- [FAULT] Release Angle (0.0° vs optimal 45°–58° (52° ideal)): Aim forearm trajectory higher at release (around 50°–55°) to improve basket entry arc.
- [PASS] Base Stability (32.3° tilt vs optimal <48.7° tilt): Stable upright core maintaining straight vertical alignment.
- [FAULT] Follow-Through (141.6° ext vs optimal ≥155° full ext): Fully lock out your shooting elbow and hold the downward wrist snap until the ball lands.

**Prescriptive Coaching Drill - Gooey Wrist-Snap Holds (3 sets of 20 repetitions):**
Truncating wrist extension immediately after release eliminates aerodynamic backspin, producing inconsistent ball flight and unpredictable bounces off the rim.
Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.

Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.

Given Moving-Sticks 3D-to-2D sagittal pose kinematics and phase telemetry extracted from uploaded video, identify the biomechanical fault class, audit all 5 checkpoints, quantify angle deviations, and prescribe targeted corrective drills.

Break down the 4 biomechanical keyframes and identify the primary shooting fault for a Center (Min Elbow=83.86 deg, Max Extension=126.69 deg, Trunk Tilt=28.5 deg, Release=0.0 deg, Wrist-Knee Lag=-6f).
input: {"sample_id": "AIM-0717", "athlete_position": "Center", "shot_context": "elbow curl mid-range jumper", "min_elbow_deg": 83.86, "max_elbow_extension_deg": 126.69, "min_knee_flexion_deg": 119.55, "max_trunk_tilt_deg": 28.5, "release_elevation_deg": 0.0, "wrist_to_knee_lag_frames": -6, "keyframes": [{"phase": "PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip", "frame": 15, "time_sec": 0.5, "elbow_deg": 85.0, "knee_deg": 119.6}, {"phase": "PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point", "frame": 22, "time_sec": 0.73, "elbow_deg": 84.1, "knee_deg": 165.8}, {"phase": "PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex", "frame": 27, "time_sec": 0.9, "elbow_deg": 85.4, "knee_deg": 170.1}, {"phase": "PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold", "frame": 45, "time_sec": 1.5, "elbow_deg": 126.7, "knee_deg": 166.6}]}
output:
### Primary Diagnosis: Short Follow-Through (Score: 76/100, Severity: Major Technique Flaw)

**Identified 4-Phase Keyframes:**
- PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip (Frame 15 / 0.5s): Elbow 85.0 deg, Knee 119.6 deg
- PHASE 2 Elbow Set-Point (Frame 22 / 0.73s): Elbow 84.1 deg, Knee 165.8 deg
- PHASE 3 Ball Release Apex (Frame 27 / 0.9s): Elbow 85.4 deg, Knee 170.1 deg
- PHASE 4 Follow-Through Hold (Frame 45 / 1.5s): Elbow 126.7 deg, Knee 166.6 deg

**5-Checkpoint Audit:**
- [PASS] Elbow Alignment (83.9° vs optimal 85°–95°): Good elbow stack directly under the ball during loading.
- [PASS] Knee Flexion (119.6° vs optimal 100°–145° dip): Balanced knee load transferring momentum smoothly upward.
- [FAULT] Release Angle (0.0° vs optimal 45°–58° (52° ideal)): Aim forearm trajectory higher at release (around 50°–55°) to improve basket entry arc.
- [PASS] Base Stability (28.5° tilt vs optimal <48.7° tilt): Stable upright core maintaining straight vertical alignment.
- [FAULT] Follow-Through (126.7° ext vs optimal ≥155° full ext): Fully lock out your shooting elbow and hold the downward wrist snap until the ball lands.

**Prescriptive Coaching Drill - Gooey Wrist-Snap Holds (3 sets of 20 repetitions):**
Truncating wrist extension immediately after release eliminates aerodynamic backspin, producing inconsistent ball flight and unpredictable bounces off the rim.
Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.

- PHASE 1 Shot Pocket / Dip (Frame 15 / 0.5s): Elbow 85.7 deg, Knee 120.4 deg

Action Cue: Hold your 'goose neck' follow-through until the basketball touches the hardwood.
